question: What months make up Spring season in Hanoi according to the handbook?

gold.evidence: Spring (February - April) This is widely considered the most pleasant season in Hanoi.

results.text: 4 SEASONS IN HANOI Spring (February - April) This is widely considered the most pleasant season in Hanoi. Expect comfortable temperatures ranging from 23°C to 28°C with low humidity and occasional light drizzles. It's a perfect time for sightseeing and exploring the city's outdoor activities. Winter (December - January) Temperatures can drop as low as 6°C with dryness. We suggest you wear warm clothes and apply moisturizer, such as lotion and lip balm.

Autumn (September - November) Autumn brings a gentle shift, with temperatures ranging from 22°C to 28°C. Humidity dips, making it perfect for outdoor adventures. This season boasts stunning fall foliage and offers a great balance for sightseeing and cultural experiences. Summer (May - August) The hottest and most humid months in Hanoi. Temperatures soar between 30°C to 38°C with frequent afternoon showers.

Take a Bus to Bat Trang Pottery Village (~15,000 VND for a local bus ride) MUST TRY DISHES IN VIETNAM Egg Coffee at Giang Cafe (39 Nguyen Huu Huan, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi) Bun Cha at Obuncha (46 Nguyen Huu Huan, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi) Trang Tien Ice Cream (35 Trang Tien Street, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi) Pho Thin Bo Ho (61 Dinh Tien Hoang Street, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi) Cha Ca La Vong (14 Cha Ca, Hang Bo Street, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi) Banh Mi at Ba Mi Sot (S212, Vinhomes oceanpark, Gia Lam District, Hanoi) 45
